Russia Accuses Estonia of Hostilities ‘On the Verge of Triggering Open War’

Russia has accused Estonia of bringing the two countries to the brink of “open war.” The Russian foreign ministry on Monday lodged a formal protest with the Estonian charge d’affaires in Moscow over Estonia’s decision to close its road border crossings with Russia.
